candidates.description: This feature vector activates strongly on common Hindi suffixes and inflectional morphemes.
This vector activates for specific Devanagari script characters, vowel signs, and conjunct consonants.
This feature vector represents common Hindi syllable fragments and character combinations used in Devanagari text processing.
The tokens represent Hindi conditional, temporal, and interrogative adverbs and pronouns indicating time, place, or condition.
This vector activates for suffixes and grammatical components in Hindi and related Indic scripts.
This feature vector represents numbers and numerical counting, primarily in the 170s range.
This vector activates for Hindi script characters and subwords alongside emotionally intense or elemental English words.
This vector represents non-English Unicode characters and Devanagari script components.
This vector activates in response to common subwords and characters found in Hindi text.
This vector represents Hindi character sequences and subwords, often functioning as phonetic fragments of borrowed English words or native terms.
